problem_text:
A logistics manager needs to select packages for a shipment. The available packages are:
* Package 1: size 29 cubic feet, revenue $199
* Package 2: size 41 cubic feet, revenue $280
* Package 3: size 4 cubic feet, revenue $202
* Package 4: size 27 cubic feet, revenue $14
* Package 5: size 27 cubic feet, revenue $174
* Package 6: size 29 cubic feet, revenue $114
* Package 7: size 24 cubic feet, revenue $160
* Package 8: size 31 cubic feet, revenue $56
* Package 9: size 12 cubic feet, revenue $65
* Package 10: size 18 cubic feet, revenue $67

The cargo container has a maximum capacity of 169 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package must be shipped entirely or not at all.
